about:
# LayoutModeForEditor
Turn any level into a layout.

Based on abandonware by willida621/radik569, who has deleted their GitHub account.

To use, open the Delete tab in the editor. For more fine-grained results, please see the mod settings.

Mod idea suggested by [joar0229](https://discord.com/users/1002209858633867385).
